messages:
maria: FYI I just reproduced an access escalation in Console. editor -> admin via the team invite flow when KMS key modal is opened. attached repro clip.

maria: steps: open project > settings > auth > click 'rotate keys' modal > back out > open team > change role dropdown for existing member > save. role becomes admin. looks like frontend state leak + API accepts role change without extra check.

tony: whoa. thanks for catching. can you attach exact request payload you saw in network tab?

maria: payload below. note role='admin' even though ui showed editor previously.

maria: ```json
{
  "project_id": "proj-7f3",
  "user_id": "u-22",
  "role": "admin"
}
```

rachel: @maria good catch. is this specific to projects with KMS enabled? or global?

maria: repro'd on two projects, both had KMS key workflow opened right before. but i also repro'd once without KMS, so root cause looks like stale role state in frontend but API accepts it.

jess: immediate mitigation: we should add a server-side assertion that only users with can_manage_roles can set admin/editor/viewer. revert UI quick fix too.

anil: agreed. add RBAC check in members API: before applying role change, verify caller has permission to assign target role and that target role isn't higher than caller's assignable cap.

anil: pseudocode: ```js
if (!hasPermission(requester, 'assign_role') || roleRank(role) > maxAssignable(requester)) {
  return 403;
}
applyRoleChange();
```

tony: i'll open GH PR for the server check + unit tests. can we also add an audit event for attempted role changes, including previous_role & ip & request_id?

rachel: yes. audit should write both successful and failed attempts to our audit log stream. we need to correlate with KMS operations too because user reported opening rotate modal.

maria: audit currently logs 'project.update' but not granular member role diffs. that's a gap.

secops-bot: Incident created: INC-4822 - console role assignment acceptance without backend gating. Priority: P1. Owner: tony.

tony: picking this up. creating PR now: GH#3421. tagging @eng-oncall and @secops.

devops-bot: Deploy pipeline started for branch fix/console-role-gating -> staging.

jess: action list:
- server-side RBAC check (owner: tony)
- audit events for role changes + failed attempts (owner: rachel)
- frontend state sanitization to not reuse modal state (owner: maria)
- correlate KMS UI events to audit logs (owner: anil)
- canary deploy to 10% users, monitor metrics (owner: eng-sre)

maria: frontend quick patch: clear role select state on modal open/close, push in hotfix branch. won't be a full rewrite but stops immediate repro. PR incoming.

anil: on KMS correlation: we'll add correlation_id to modal flows and log modal_open/modal_close as audit events. KMS rotations already emit events to cloudwatch but need cross-link by request header.

jess: add tests for audit retention query to ensure we can search for attempts by user and by correlation_id.

tony: PR merged to staging. canary deploy in 15m. monitoring: 500s on members API, role-change success rate, and audit sink errors.

devops-bot: Canary rollout 10% -> success.

maria: tried the exact repro flow on staging after canary, cannot reproduce. :tada:

rachel: i'll implement the audit schema: event_type=role_change_attempt, fields=[requester, target_user, previous_role, requested_role, outcome, correlation_id, ip, request_id, timestamp].

secops-bot: Note: we've flagged related logs for a 24h retention increase while we investigate (INC-4822).

tony: after canary we should run a quick scan across production audit logs for any role_change_attempts where outcome=success + requester lacking assign_role in last 7 days. add query and run.

anil: i'll also run KMS operation correlation to see if any rotation flows happened around suspicious role changes.

jess: timeline for full rollout: finish tests + audit + correlation by EOD tomorrow, global rollout after 48h of stability on canary.

maria: also opened a vuln triage ticket to see if this constitutes a CVE or internal advisory: VT-129. tagging compliance.

rachel: one more: update Console docs and admin checklist to recommend limiting who can assign admin roles and to enable multi-person approval for role escalations in high-sensitivity orgs.

tony: good. i'll post an incident summary to #incidents after we confirm production scan.

maria: thanks all. feel free to @me if you need repro clip or extra logs.

secops-bot: INC-4822 status update: triage complete. next update in 2 hours or on request.
